verdict.rationale: Stripe ships a first-party hosted MCP server and official agent plugins that let an AI agent read and write account data across a broad API surface. Its docs give natural-language example prompts such as "What's my MRR for the last 6 months, by month?", and sensitive writes require human approval. However, the natural-language layer comes from an external agent client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), and the evidence shows no built-in natural-language command interface in the product itself. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command surface in the Dashboard, natural-language examples for write operations beyond analytics and provisioning, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
Example prompts: "What's my MRR for the last 6 months, by month?", "Run the balance summary report for last month."
tell your agent e.g. "Use Stripe Projects to set up a Next.js app with Supabase, Vercel, and PostHog"
Stripe requires human confirmation before it takes certain stripe_api_write actions, such as refunds and outbound payments.
